one_line: AI sees massive funding, new model releases, NVIDIA's ecosystem growth, and fresh research benchmarks.

themes.title: DeepSeek raises $15 billion
themes.text: DeepSeek, a Chinese AI startup, secured roughly 100 billion yuan ($15 billion) from investors including CATL and Tencent, two days after U.S. agencies were ordered to remove its technology.

stories.headline: DeepSeek raises about $15 billion in funding round days after US restrictions

themes.title: New multimodal and agent models
themes.text: Mistral AI previewed its 1‑trillion‑parameter multimodal Mistral Large 4 model and launched the Voxtral 3 voice‑agent SDK with multilingual speech models. Anthropic released Claude Duet, a proactive AI agent running on Opus 5.5, and OpenAI announced that its GPT‑6 and GPT‑6.1 models will be available on Google Cloud for select enterprise customers.

stories.headline: Mistral AI opens preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1‑trillion‑parameter multimodal model
Mistral AI releases Voxtral 3 voice agent SDK with multilingual speech models
Anthropic launches Claude Duet AI agent in research preview
OpenAI’s GPT‑6, 6.1 models to be available on Google Cloud

themes.title: NVIDIA expands AI infrastructure
themes.text: NVIDIA introduced the Minerva AIOps platform for AI factory observability and expanded its open‑weight models into European public‑sector projects, weather and climate forecasting, and retail inference cost reductions. The company also launched the DSX AI Factory platform to integrate power infrastructure and added new training tools and data‑factory blueprints to its Cosmos platform.

themes.title: Research benchmarks test AI reasoning
themes.text: Researchers evaluated six frontier AI models on the LIBERO‑10 robot manipulation suite, with GPT‑6 Astra achieving a 44 % success rate. New frameworks such as PAPAV defined five functions for multimodal embodied agents, while the Environment Duels benchmark examined LLM co‑evolution in author‑solver interactions. Microsoft researchers used a human‑directed AI process to prove the 31‑year‑old KLS conjecture in high‑dimensional geometry.
